_comment: Reference data for CQED response theory; Tier 0 of docs/development/QED_RESPONSE_PLAN.md.
All entries are (CQED-HF orbitals, coherent-state basis).
Provenance is recorded per entry: 'measured' values are transcribed from a tested
upstream suite; 'derived' values are computed here and are themselves under test.
NOTE: no trustworthy canonical-HF-orbital reference values exist upstream --
qed-ci's test_mghp_qed_cis_with_cavity_canonical_mo is an anti-test with its
asserts stripped.  Truncated CI is not orbital invariant; see plan section 0.5.

cavity._helper_provenance: measured: CS_CQED_CIS.py CASE 2 compare_values to 8 digits. This is E_LP - E_CQED_RHF, NOT an excitation energy.
cavity._cqed_rhf_provenance: DERIVED and under test: qed_ci lower_polariton minus helper_eigenvalue_1.
cavity._excitation_provenance: DERIVED: qed_ci total minus qed_ci ground; the true omega_k = E_k - E_0.
